children: The Genius Foundation has ended a vote on how to allocate about $125,000 in BNB that cannot be unwrapped and redeemed for underlying shares. According to Odaily, 50% will be allocated to GSTOCK and 50% to GENIUS, or about $62,500 each.

The funds came from fee accumulation that entered the foundation treasury through the Genius.fun issuance platform. The foundation said it will carry out the result of the vote and announce the completion on X.

title: Genius Foundation Ends Vote on $125,000 BNB Allocation to GSTOCK and GENIUS
